newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Beverage adds Arizona brand.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Beverage adds Arizona brand.

text.p: Atlantic Beverage Co Inc said Friday it signed a licensing and distribution agreement to add the Arizona beverage brand to its roster of premium specialty products.
Financial terms of the agreement were not announced.

Atlantic said its subsidiary in Baltimore will become the exclusive distributor of Arizona beverages in Washington, D.C., and three counties in Maryland as part of a pact with Hornell Brewing Co in Lake Success, New York.
Atlantic markets processed meat products and specialty non-alcoholic beverages.
Its shares were unchanged Friday at 4.
